prerequisite.p3: P3 has 72 valid processes, all 24 certificates and prefixes, but Stage B solver controls and Stage C science require accepted P3 source/certificate/cost independent review.
prerequisite.no_selection: No timing outcome selects any parameter.

ic_candidate.definition: P3 target-certificate source plus exact P2 x_only capacity doubling and common ARM work

arms.rho_candidate: same rho algorithm plus identical common ARM field primitives/inversion work

invariants: Both IC arms K75 eta1/256 doubled capacity; no base/Bloom/RNG/relation/witness/rank-targeting/group-validation change. Candidate charges all P3 certificate costs and all group checks. New receipts have separate IDs; prior RNG domains/task IDs remain unchanged.

arm_work.common: AES/PMULL-gated fused multiply/square plus twofold reduction modulo x^53+x^6+x^2+x+1; n53 Itoh chain 1,2,4,8,16,32,48,52 then one square, in IC and rho. Preserve generic n13/other degree/x86 paths and separate ARM guards; do not broaden old x86 predicates.
arm_work.ic: Port x86 compact-dual-sign n53 query batch into ARM target-feature function, hoist checks to batch entry, preserve key/sign/exception/filter/lazyY/lookup/output order.
arm_work.markers: Receipts report truthful backend, inversion and actual ARM query-branch markers.

stages.A: Executor implementation/offline build/native and deterministic unit controls only.
stages.B: After accepted P3 review, Coordinator binds exact source/diffs/binaries/unit/case evidence then authorizes eight untimed controls.
stages.C: Commit all eight receipts and admission; sole owner launches science.

controls.field: For 2809 basis products and 53 basis squares compare independent bitwise oracle; test zero/one/max/alternating; test 256 values 1+SHA256little('CSIC53-ARMCOMPOSE-v1-field-XXX')%((1<<53)-1), XXX000..255, inverse identity against binary reference/bitwise product, and symbolic Itoh exponent.
controls.p3: Repeat exact P3 p=17/r/K75 certificate null suite.
controls.batch: Targets 0,1,2,7,31; widths 0,1,8,63,257,4096; arrays cycle [0]G..[63]G plus order2 (0,1); table [0]G..[64]G plus (0,1), identical x domain. Generic/ARM output/order/counters/group identities agree including infinity,cancellation,doubling,x0. No full n53 solver unit check.
controls.helper: Any helper-shape issue is Coordinator-resolved before controls, never silently changed.

untimed_solver_controls: Exactly eight: all four arms at n13/a0/scalar17/seed13001 (IC eta1/2), and all four at n53/a0/scalar17/seed53001 (IC eta1/256). Verify IC prefixes/certificates/outputs/backend/actual n53 native branch; rho walk_steps, charges, restarts, table_entries and answer agree. Parent timing/CPU/RSS discarded; internal timing diagnostic only.

panel.scalars: d=1+SHA256little('CSIC53-ARMCOMPOSE-v1-case-XX')%(r-1), XX01..24, r=21044858204113; unique and disjoint all 84 R1/R2/R3 scalars and 17 or refuse.
panel.seeds: shared IC first8-SHA-little CSIC53-ARMCOMPOSE-v1-ic-seed-XX; shared rho analogous rho-seed-XX.
panel.order: All 24 lexicographic permutations of [ic_baseline,ic_candidate,rho_baseline,rho_candidate] once: 96 serial fresh children, each arm six times per position.

measurement.primary: new IC/new rho all 24 eligible: median<.95 and 10k paired-bootstrap upper<1 using Random('CSIC53-ARMCOMPOSE-BOOT-v1'), 24 draws, type7 .025/.975.
measurement.eligibility: all 24 IC prefix controls, all 24 rho semantic controls, certificates, group checks and telemetry valid.
measurement.secondary: newIC/ICbaseline, newrho/oldrho, newIC/oldrho, ICbaseline/oldrho wall/CPU/RSS/counters/stages. Never substitute old-rho win for new-rho primary.

resources.boundary: wait4 whole process; requested 1ms wait and 50ms footprint; 8GiB cooperative cap; 240s watchdog; no retry/drop/build amortization; fresh solver state/directories/processes, no OS-cache or thermal claim.

argv.controls: n=13 eta=2 and n=53 eta=256; all six environment flags apply to every arm

artifacts.hash_binding: runner, analyzer, separate receipt/certificate/prefix/rho-semantics/backend/correctness/telemetry checkers SHA-256-bound before controls

field_controls_precision.alternating_edges: sums of 1<<i for even i and for odd i
field_controls_precision.inversion: GF(2^53) raw_inverse, never scalar inverse_mod; scalar arithmetic unchanged

batch_fixture.points: reference-generate [0]G through [64]G plus order-two (0,1), yielding 66 distinct compact x keys
batch_fixture.table: CompactPairTable expected=66, x_only=true, x_domain=(1<<53)+1; verify 66 insertions and exact lookup membership
batch_fixture.dummy: unused witness columns [0,0]/coefficients [0,0] permitted with image_y from each actual point; this is batch arithmetic/x-filter testing, not relation proof
batch_fixture.comparison: generic/ARM ordered outputs, attempted counters and independent group identities agree; filtered outputs retain normal Bloom-candidate false-positive semantics, so Bloom-positive does not imply exact table member
batch_fixture.change_rule: mechanical Rust conversions allowed; point/width/target/semantic changes require Coordinator resolution

design_completion.failure_boundary: Field, certificate, prefix, rho-semantic, backend, correctness, or telemetry failure preserves raw records and invalidates applicable eligibility. Mismatch or unexpected backend/source/certificate correctness stops further launches for Coordinator review, without retry.

proof_search_map.exact_baseline_reproduction: P2/P3 bound parent sources and frozen four arms
proof_search_map.observation_collision_search: field oracle, P3 certificate null suite, batch generic/ARM and rho semantic controls
proof_search_map.quantifiers: fixed source/host/24 cases/96 processes and conditional certificate correctness
proof_search_map.method_ceiling: no assumed timing/asymptotic/superiority claim; full matched controls may falsify mechanism

inference.serving_probe: no current serving probe; identity verification false

prior: Common primitives may accelerate rho substantially; no win is assumed.
